name: Love Me Tender
overview: After uncovering her husband’s affair, Ke Yurou, a former dancer trapped in a seven-year marriage of convenience, decides to walk away and fight back. Targeted by her ruthless mother-in-law’s scheme to seize her family’s wealth, she finds an unexpected ally in Li Haoqing. As betrayals unravel and loyalties shift, Ke Yurou fights to reclaim her life, her inheritance, and a chance at true love.
